_doc: Standby on the pessimistic Plus profile (foundation §7, power service): idle clock, power-key lock, light sleep in 60 s slices, wake keys, auto lock. Currents are ESTIMATES (profile power section) until SP-14/SP-10: the current budgets are regression guards (a hold or a busy service that keeps the chip awake while locked fails them), not battery-life promises.

warnings.count.why: a simulator warning means the run is not clean

reader.page_turns.why: the two page turns while unlocked work; the touch and the cover key while locked and asleep must not reach the reader, not even after the wake

power.to_locked.why: power key twice (the first lock is undone at once), and the automatic lock after 10 minutes without input

power.wakes.ai_key.why: the AI key is a wake source too (upstream arms only POWER)

power.wakes.timer.why: light sleep in 60 s slices (upstream): about one timer wake per minute locked

power.inputs_lost_asleep.why: touch and cover keys are not wake sources: the chip never sees them while it sleeps

power.locked_sleep_share.why: asleep for at least 95% of the locked time (the rest: lock mark refresh, slice wake-ups, key wakes)

power.avg_ma.locked.why: standby with the 4G rail kept up (answerable standby): sleep floor 1.5 mA + modem rail 5 mA + slices + lock mark, all estimates (SP-10); a chip kept awake while locked costs ~28 mA and fails this

power.lock_to_sleep_ms.max.why: lock -> lock mark on the panel -> chip asleep (the chip must not sleep before the mark is drawn)

power.unlock_to_visible_ms.max.why: wake key (or a quick unlock during the sleep entry) -> lock mark off, the page fully back (TEXT waveform)

power.sleep_aborted.why: something started during the sleep entry sequence: the quiet check before it missed work

power.sleep_cancelled.why: the quick unlock lands in the sleep entry sequence and must cancel the sleep (otherwise the unlock waits for the next 60 s slice and power.unlock_to_visible_ms fails); if model timings move, move the second key press so it still lands there

ui.action_to_visible_ms.TEXT.p95.why: page turns after a wake are as fast as before
